methodology: Atomic requirements normalized from the supplied PartsA-N and existing approved specifications. The opening96-checkpoint summary omits item names in six groups and combines subfeatures; this file expands named subfeatures rather than asserting an artificial96-row total. Priorities are audit risk classifications, not approval to defer launch scope. Eighteen supporting flows from the approved delivery/acceptance documents are retained explicitly rather than hidden inside broad module labels. Opportunity proposals without activation/scope approval are not silently treated as implemented or approved deferrals.
